You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

Wato ni abunda yake bani mamaki, kullun ƙara samo wasu kuɗi ake wajan 'yan ƙasa, wanda wannan kuɗin sun kasance mallakin ƙasa. Amma kuma kullun ƙara ciwoma ƙasa bashi ake yi. Shin ko mi ye takamai-man zance??? Sannan kuma bamuga hanyar da ake bi da wannan kuɗin ba.👌👌👌

output.original_text: Wato ni abunda yake bani mamaki, kullun ƙara samo wasu kuɗi ake wajan 'yan ƙasa, wanda wannan kuɗin sun kasance mallakin ƙasa. Amma kuma kullun ƙara ciwoma ƙasa bashi ake yi. Shin ko mi ye takamai-man zance??? Sannan kuma bamuga hanyar da ake bi da wannan kuɗin ba.👌👌👌

output.sadness: Wato ni abunda yake bani mamaki, kullun ina ganin yadda ake samun wasu kuɗi daga 'yan ƙasa, ko da kuwa wannan kuɗin mallakin ƙasa ne. Amma kullun ina jin ciwon ƙasa, ba a yin wani abu mai kyau da shi. Shin ko mi ye takamai-man zance??? Sannan kuma ba mu ga yadda ake bi da wannan kuɗin ba, hakan yana jawo mana damuwa.
output.fear: Wato ni abunda yake bani mamaki, kullun ina jin tsoro game da yadda ake samo wasu kuɗi daga 'yan ƙasa, wanda wannan kuɗin sun kasance mallakin ƙasa. Amma kullun ina jin cewa ƙara ciwon ƙasa bashi da lafiya. Shin ko mi ye takamai-man zance??? Sannan kuma ko za mu sami hanyar da za mu kare wannan kuɗin ba?
output.anger: Wato ni abunda yake bani mamaki, kullun na gaji da yadda ake samun kuɗi daga 'yan ƙasa, wanda wannan kuɗin mallakin ƙasa ne. Amma kuma kullun akwai ciwo da aka jefa ƙasa, wannan ba zai ci gaba ba! Shin ko mi ye takamai-man zance??? Sannan kuma ina so mu ga ko mene ne hanyar da ake bi da wannan kuɗin!
output.surprise: Wato ni abunda yake bani mamaki, kullun ina gaji da yadda ake samun wasu kuɗi daga 'yan ƙasa, wanda wannan kuɗin sun kasance mallakin ƙasa! Amma kuma ina jin haushi da ciwon ƙasa ba a cikin wannan tsarin. Shin ko mi ye takamai-man zance??? Sannan kuma, ga matakan da ake ɗauka da wannan kuɗin, ba ma ji daɗi!
